description_full: Supernus, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of buprenorphine-based prescription drugs for the treatment of opioid dependence and related disorders in the United States, Europe, Canada, Australia, and internationally. It develops medicines to treat substance use disorders. The company's core marketed products include SUBLOCADE buprenorphine extended-release monthly injections; and SUBOXONE Film, a buprenorphine and naloxone sublingual film. It also manufactures SUBOXONE Tablet, a buprenorphine and naloxone sublingual tablet; and SUBUTEX Tablet, a buprenorphine sublingual tablet for the treatment of opioid use disorder (OUD). In addition, the company is developing INDV-2000, a selective orexin-1 receptor antagonist that is in Phase 2 clinical trial for the treatment of moderate to severe OUD; and INDV-6001, a buprenorphine-based long-acting injectable for the treatment of OUD in collaboration with Alar Pharmaceuticals Inc. Supernus, Inc. was formerly known as Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. and changed its name Supernus, Inc. in November 2026. Supernus, Inc. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Rockville, Maryland.

The company is burning through $93M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
Accruals are elevated at +19.7% of assets, and Sloan showed firms building earnings through accruals rather than cash systematically underperform.
On the balance sheet, leverage is comfortably conservative at 0.5× net debt/EBITDA, and interest coverage runs at 5.8×.

Shareholder yield is only 0.6%, a thin return of capital, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome, and within its sector the business captures 2.4× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
